name: Kia Stinger 3.3T (P-CAN)
notes: Powertrain/chassis bus, 500 kbit/s. Sources: 'verified' = confirmed on this car (against a gauge, a tool, the ECU's calibration or code, or its captures); 'dbc' = comma's hyundai_can.dbc; 'observed' = inferred from captures. Signal notes give the detail (DBC, CODE = traced in the ECU's CAN packer, CAP = confirmed in this car's captures). Boost in psi assumes 101.3 kPa atmospheric.

signals.label: Engine speed
signals.note: EMS11 N. Checked against the tach. DBC+CAP

signals.label: Boost pressure (absolute)
signals.note: EMS19 CR_Ems_BstPre, 12-bit x1.322 hPa, pre-throttle. DBC+CODE

signals.label: Boost
signals.note: The 12-bit boost pressure as psi above 101.3 kPa. Pre-throttle, so no vacuum. DBC+CODE

signals.label: Manifold pressure
signals.note: Absolute. 94 engine off, 34-52 at idle, matched a tuner's datalog on a pull. Tops out at 255

signals.label: Throttle
signals.note: EMS12 TPS. DBC

signals.label: Throttle (OBD)
signals.note: Absolute throttle as OBD PID 11 reports it; matched the ECU's answers within 0.14 %. 0x329's TPS is a different measure

signals.label: Calculated engine load
signals.note: OBD PID 04 encoding (raw x 100/255). Equal to the transmission's PID 04 answers (7E9) on 94% of them (r 0.982, and 0.978 with RPM held); the engine's own PID 04 (7E8) less closely (r 0.898), so likely the load the ECU sends the transmission, slightly smoothed. Tracks manifold pressure (r 0.984), reaches about 93% at WOT and reads 0 on overrun. 0x556 carries OBD-encoded values: byte 1 is coolant + 40 (r 0.9997 against the ECU's PID 05 over a cold start), byte 5 is throttle_obd

signals.label: Intake bank 1 off target
signals.note: More than 10 deg from target. The ECU allows 10 deg before P0011/P0021; sustained means a phaser problem. Only with the engine running: with it off the target reads 'no target' and the last value would linger

signals.label: Exhaust bank 1 off target
signals.note: More than 10 deg from target. The ECU allows 10 deg before P0014/P0024; sustained means a phaser problem. Only with the engine running: with it off the target reads 'no target' and the last value would linger

signals.label: Intake bank 2 off target
signals.note: More than 10 deg from target. Only with the engine running: with it off the target reads 'no target' and the last value would linger

signals.label: Exhaust bank 2 off target
signals.note: More than 10 deg from target. Only with the engine running: with it off the target reads 'no target' and the last value would linger

signals.label: Intake bank 1 cam slow
signals.expr: (intake_b1_lag > max(1.5 * (intake_b1_lag + exhaust_b1_lag + intake_b2_lag + exhaust_b2_lag) / 4, (intake_b1_lag + exhaust_b1_lag + intake_b2_lag + exhaust_b2_lag) / 4 + 2)) * (rpm > 400)
signals.note: Tracks its target worse than the four cams' mean (over 1.5x it, and 2 deg more). From the SIM2K-260 drive logs: intake bank 1 lags 200-330 ms against 40-100 ms for the others, and lights 12-14% of a drive; the others never do
